title: Re-audit stale Moon Suite engineering evidence
prompt: Review the MoonProj engineering-control book for all registered Moon Suite projects. Treat projections older than seven days as stale. For each stale or missing project, open a needs-review decision that tells an authenticated operator to launch the audit from the MoonProj Moon Suite UI. Do not invent a rating, do not ingest evidence directly, and do not create remediation until MoonProj reports an accepted independent-review verdict.
